items.chinese: 請問你是陳月美小姐嗎？
items.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ shì Chén Yuèměi xiǎojiě ma?
items.english: Excuse me, are you Miss Chen Yuemei?

items.chinese: 是的。謝謝你來接我們。
items.pinyin: Shì de. Xièxie nǐ lái jiē wǒmen.
items.english: Yes. Thank you for coming to pick us up.

items.chinese: 不客氣。我是李明華。
items.pinyin: Bú kèqi. Wǒ shì Lǐ Mínghuá.
items.english: You're welcome. I'm Li Minghua.

items.chinese: 這是王先生。
items.pinyin: Zhè shì Wáng xiānsheng.
items.english: This is Mr. Wang.

items.chinese: 你好。我姓王，叫開文。
items.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Wǒ xìng Wáng, jiào Kāiwén.
items.english: Hello. My surname is Wang, and my given name is Kaiwen.

items.chinese: 你們好。歡迎你們來臺灣。
items.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo. Huānyíng nǐmen lái Táiwān.
items.english: Hello, both of you. Welcome to Taiwan.

items.chinese: 請喝茶。
items.pinyin: Qǐng hē chá.
items.english: Please have some tea.

items.chinese: 謝謝。很好喝。請問這是什麼茶？
items.pinyin: Xièxie. Hěn hǎohē. Qǐngwèn zhè shì shénme chá?
items.english: Thank you. It is delicious. May I ask what kind of tea this is?

items.chinese: 這是烏龍茶。臺灣人喜歡喝茶。開文，你們日本人呢？
items.pinyin: Zhè shì Wūlóng chá. Táiwān rén xǐhuan hē chá. Kāiwén, nǐmen Rìběn rén ne?
items.english: This is oolong tea. Taiwanese people like drinking tea. Kaiwen, what about you Japanese people?

items.chinese: 他不是日本人。
items.pinyin: Tā bú shì Rìběn rén.
items.english: He is not Japanese.

items.chinese: 對不起，你是哪國人？
items.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
items.english: Sorry, what country are you from?

items.chinese: 我是美國人。
items.pinyin: Wǒ shì Měiguó rén.
items.english: I am American.

items.chinese: 開文，你要不要喝咖啡？
items.pinyin: Kāiwén, nǐ yào bú yào hē kāfēi?
items.english: Kaiwen, would you like some coffee?

items.chinese: 謝謝！我不喝咖啡，我喜歡喝茶。
items.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ bù hē kāfēi, wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
items.english: Thank you! I do not drink coffee; I like drinking tea.

items.chinese: 這是我家。請進！
items.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ jiā. Qǐng jìn!
items.english: This is my home. Please come in!

items.chinese: 很漂亮的房子！
items.pinyin: Hěn piàoliang de fángzi!
items.english: What a beautiful house!

items.chinese: 請坐！要不要喝茶？
items.pinyin: Qǐng zuò! Yào bú yào hē chá?
items.english: Please sit down! Would you like some tea?

items.chinese: 好，謝謝你。你家有很多照片。
items.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie nǐ. Nǐ jiā yǒu hěn duō zhàopiàn.
items.english: Yes, thank you. Your home has many photographs.

items.chinese: 我家人都很喜歡照相。
items.pinyin: Wǒ jiārén dōu hěn xǐhuan zhàoxiàng.
items.english: Everyone in my family likes taking photographs.

items.chinese: 這張照片很好看。這是誰？你姐姐嗎？
items.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn hěn hǎokàn. Zhè shì shéi? Nǐ jiějie ma?
items.english: This photograph looks very nice. Who is this? Is she your older sister?

items.chinese: 不是，是我妹妹。這是我爸爸、媽媽。
items.pinyin: Bú shì, shì wǒ mèimei. Zhè shì wǒ bàba, māma.
items.english: No, she is my younger sister. These are my father and mother.

items.chinese: 你家人都很好看。
items.pinyin: Nǐ jiārén dōu hěn hǎokàn.
items.english: Everyone in your family is good-looking.

items.chinese: 田中，歡迎！歡迎！請進。
items.pinyin: Tiánzhōng, huānyíng! Huānyíng! Qǐng jìn.
items.english: Tianzhong, welcome! Welcome! Please come in.

items.chinese: 謝謝。
items.pinyin: Xièxie.
items.english: Thank you.

items.chinese: 田中，這是我媽媽。
items.pinyin: Tiánzhōng, zhè shì wǒ māma.
items.english: Tianzhong, this is my mother.

items.chinese: 伯母，您好。
items.pinyin: Bómǔ, nín hǎo.
items.english: Hello, ma’am.

items.chinese: 你好，你好。來！來！來！請坐。你叫什麼名字？
items.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo. Lái! Lái! Lái! Qǐng zuò. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
items.english: Hello, hello. Come in! Come in! Please sit down. What is your name?

items.chinese: 我叫誠一。你們家有很多書。
items.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Chéngyī. Nǐmen jiā yǒu hěn duō shū.
items.english: My name is Chengyi. Your family has many books.

items.chinese: 都是我哥哥的書。他是老師，他很喜歡看書。
items.pinyin: Dōu shì wǒ gēge de shū. Tā shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuan kànshū.
items.english: They are all my older brother’s books. He is a teacher, and he really likes reading.

items.chinese: 誠一，你家有幾個人？你有沒有兄弟姐妹？
items.pinyin: Chéngyī, nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén? Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi?
items.english: Chengyi, how many people are in your family? Do you have any brothers or sisters?

items.chinese: 我家有五個人，我有兩個妹妹。
items.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ ge rén, wǒ yǒu liǎng ge mèimei.
items.english: There are five people in my family. I have two younger sisters.

items.chinese: 田中，你喜歡聽音樂嗎？
items.pinyin: Tiánzhōng, nǐ xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè ma?
items.english: Tianzhong, do you like listening to music?

items.chinese: 我不喜歡聽音樂。我喜歡運動。
items.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè. Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng.
items.english: I do not like listening to music. I like sports.

items.chinese: 你喜歡打網球嗎？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan dǎ wǎngqiú ma?
items.english: Do you like playing tennis?

items.chinese: 我不喜歡打網球。
items.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan dǎ wǎngqiú.
items.english: I do not like playing tennis.

items.chinese: 你喜歡做什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan zuò shénme?
items.english: What do you like doing?

items.chinese: 打棒球和游泳，你呢？
items.pinyin: Dǎ bàngqiú hàn yóuyǒng, nǐ ne?
items.english: Playing baseball and swimming. What about you?

items.chinese: 我常打籃球，也常踢足球。
items.pinyin: Wǒ cháng dǎ lánqiú, yě cháng tī zúqiú.
items.english: I often play basketball, and I also often play soccer.

items.chinese: 我覺得踢足球很好玩。
items.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tī zúqiú hěn hǎowán.
items.english: I think playing soccer is a lot of fun.

items.chinese: 明天是週末，我們早上去踢足球，怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Míngtiān shì zhōumò. Wǒmen zǎoshang qù tī zúqiú, zěnmeyàng?
items.english: Tomorrow is the weekend. How about we go play soccer in the morning?

items.chinese: 好啊！
items.pinyin: Hǎo a!
items.english: Sounds good!

items.chinese: 今天晚上我們去看電影，好不好？
items.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo bù hǎo?
items.english: Shall we go see a movie tonight?

items.chinese: 好啊！
items.pinyin: Hǎo a!
items.english: Sounds good!

items.chinese: 妳想看美國電影還是臺灣電影？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng kàn Měiguó diànyǐng háishi Táiwān diànyǐng?
items.english: Do you want to see an American movie or a Taiwanese movie?

items.chinese: 美國電影、臺灣電影，我都想看。
items.pinyin: Měiguó diànyǐng, Táiwān diànyǐng, wǒ dōu xiǎng kàn.
items.english: I want to see both American and Taiwanese movies.

items.chinese: 我們看臺灣電影吧！
items.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn Táiwān diànyǐng ba!
items.english: Let’s watch a Taiwanese movie!

items.chinese: 好啊！看電影可以學中文。
items.pinyin: Hǎo a! Kàn diànyǐng kěyǐ xué Zhōngwén.
items.english: Sounds good! Watching movies can help us learn Chinese.

items.chinese: 晚上要不要一起吃晚飯？
items.pinyin: Wǎnshang yào bú yào yìqǐ chī wǎnfàn?
items.english: Would you like to eat dinner together tonight?

items.chinese: 好，我們去吃越南菜。
items.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen qù chī Yuènán cài.
items.english: Okay, let’s go eat Vietnamese food.

items.chinese: 請問你要買什麼？
items.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ yào mǎi shénme?
items.english: May I ask what you would like to buy?

items.chinese: 一杯熱咖啡。兩個包子。
items.pinyin: Yì bēi rè kāfēi. Liǎng ge bāozi.
items.english: One cup of hot coffee and two steamed buns.

items.chinese: 你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？
items.pinyin: Nǐ yào dà bēi, zhōng bēi háishi xiǎo bēi?
items.english: Would you like a large, medium, or small cup?

items.chinese: 大杯。包子請幫我微波。
items.pinyin: Dà bēi. Bāozi qǐng bāng wǒ wéibō.
items.english: A large. Please microwave the steamed buns for me.

items.chinese: 好的。請問外帶還是內用？
items.pinyin: Hǎode. Qǐngwèn wàidài háishi nèiyòng?
items.english: Okay. Is that to go or for here?

items.chinese: 外帶，一共多少錢？
items.pinyin: Wàidài, yígòng duōshǎo qián?
items.english: To go. How much is it altogether?

items.chinese: 咖啡八十，包子四十，一共一百二十塊。
items.pinyin: Kāfēi bāshí, bāozi sìshí, yígòng yìbǎi èrshí kuài.
items.english: The coffee is eighty, the steamed buns are forty—one hundred and twenty dollars altogether.

items.chinese: 我想買一支新手機。
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì zhī xīn shǒujī.
items.english: I want to buy a new mobile phone.

items.chinese: 妳的手機很好。為什麼要買新的？
items.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī hěn hǎo. Wèishénme yào mǎi xīn de?
items.english: Your mobile phone is very good. Why do you want to buy a new one?

items.chinese: 我這支手機太舊了，不好看。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zhè zhī shǒujī tài jiù le, bù hǎokàn.
items.english: This mobile phone of mine is too old and does not look good.

items.chinese: 妳想買哪種手機？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ zhǒng shǒujī?
items.english: What kind of mobile phone do you want to buy?

items.chinese: 能照相也能上網。
items.pinyin: Néng zhàoxiàng yě néng shàngwǎng.
items.english: One that can take photos and access the internet.

items.chinese: 那種手機很好，我哥哥有一支。
items.pinyin: Nà zhǒng shǒujī hěn hǎo, wǒ gēge yǒu yì zhī.
items.english: That kind of mobile phone is very good. My older brother has one.

items.chinese: 貴不貴？一支賣多少錢？
items.pinyin: Guì bú guì? Yì zhī mài duōshǎo qián?
items.english: Is it expensive? How much does one cost?

items.chinese: 那種手機不便宜。一支要一萬五千多。
items.pinyin: Nà zhǒng shǒujī bù piányí. Yì zhī yào yíwàn wǔqiān duō.
items.english: That kind of phone is not cheap. One costs more than fifteen thousand.

items.chinese: 很多人都說臺灣有不少有名的小吃。
items.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu shuō Táiwān yǒu bù shǎo yǒumíng de xiǎochī.
items.english: Many people say Taiwan has quite a few famous snacks.

items.chinese: 是啊！牛肉麵、小籠包、臭豆腐……都很好吃。
items.pinyin: Shì a. Niúròu miàn, xiǎolóngbāo, chòu dòufu... dōu hěn hǎochī.
items.english: Yes! Beef noodles, soup dumplings, stinky tofu… they are all delicious.

items.chinese: 你最喜歡吃什麼？
items.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan chī shénme?
items.english: What do you like eating most?

items.chinese: 牛肉麵。牛肉好吃，湯也好喝。
items.pinyin: Niúròu miàn. Niúròu hǎochī, tāng yě hǎohē.
items.english: Beef noodles. The beef is delicious, and the soup tastes good too.

items.chinese: 這麼好吃，我很想吃。
items.pinyin: Zhème hǎochī, wǒ hěn xiǎng chī.
items.english: It sounds so delicious. I really want to try it.

items.chinese: 我知道一家有名的牛肉麵店，我們一起去吃，怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā yǒumíng de niúròu miàn diàn. Wǒmen yìqǐ qù chī, zěnmeyàng?
items.english: I know a famous beef noodle shop. How about we go eat there together?

items.chinese: 太好了！
items.pinyin: Tài hǎo le!
items.english: Great!

items.chinese: 我們明天去。一定要點大碗的。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān qù. Yídìng yào diǎn dà wǎn de.
items.english: We’ll go tomorrow. You definitely have to order a large bowl.

items.chinese: 昨天晚上那家餐廳的菜很好吃，可是有一點辣。
items.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang nà jiā cāntīng de cài hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒu yìdiǎn là.
items.english: The food at that restaurant last night was delicious, but it was a little spicy.

items.chinese: 我也怕辣，所以我喜歡自己做飯。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yě pà là, suǒyǐ wǒ xǐhuan zìjǐ zuòfàn.
items.english: I am also afraid of spicy food, so I like cooking for myself.

items.chinese: 你做飯做得怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Nǐ zuòfàn zuò de zěnmeyàng?
items.english: How well do you cook?

items.chinese: 我做得不好。妳會做飯嗎？
items.pinyin: Wǒ zuò de bù hǎo. Nǐ huì zuòfàn ma?
items.english: I do not cook well. Can you cook?

items.chinese: 會。我的甜點也做得不錯。
items.pinyin: Huì. Wǒ de tiándiǎn yě zuò de búcuò.
items.english: Yes. I also make desserts quite well.

items.chinese: 我最喜歡吃甜點。妳可以教我嗎？
items.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī tiándiǎn. Nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
items.english: I like eating desserts most. Can you teach me?

items.chinese: 好的，這個週末，你到我家來。
items.pinyin: Hǎode, zhè ge zhōumò, nǐ dào wǒ jiā lái.
items.english: Okay. Come to my home this weekend.

items.chinese: 好啊！謝謝妳。
items.pinyin: Hǎo a! Xièxie nǐ.
items.english: Great! Thank you.

items.chinese: 聽說怡君的學校很漂亮。
items.pinyin: Tīngshuō Yíjūn de xuéxiào hěn piàoliang.
items.english: I heard that Yijun’s school is very beautiful.

items.chinese: 他們學校在哪裡？遠不遠？
items.pinyin: Tāmen xuéxiào zài nǎlǐ? Yuǎn bù yuǎn?
items.english: Where is their school? Is it far?

items.chinese: 有一點遠。他們學校在花蓮的山上。
items.pinyin: Yǒu yìdiǎn yuǎn. Tāmen xuéxiào zài Huālián de shān shàng.
items.english: It is a little far. Their school is in the mountains of Hualien.

items.chinese: 山上？那裡的風景一定很美。
items.pinyin: Shān shàng? Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng yídìng hěn měi.
items.english: In the mountains? The scenery there must be beautiful.

items.chinese: 是的，他們學校前面有海，後面有山，那裡真的是一個很漂亮的地方。
items.pinyin: Shì de, tāmen xuéxiào qiánmiàn yǒu hǎi, hòumiàn yǒu shān, nàlǐ zhēnde shì yí ge hěn piàoliang de dìfang.
items.english: Yes. There is the sea in front of their school and mountains behind it. It truly is a beautiful place.

items.chinese: 我想去看看。我們這個週末一起去吧！
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù kànkan. Wǒmen zhè ge zhōumò yìqǐ qù ba!
items.english: I would like to go and have a look. Let’s go together this weekend!

items.chinese: 好啊！我現在要去學校附近的咖啡店買咖啡。妳呢？
items.pinyin: Hǎo a! Wǒ xiànzài yào qù xuéxiào fùjìn de kāfēidiàn mǎi kāfēi. Nǐ ne?
items.english: Sure! I’m going to the coffee shop near the school to buy coffee now. What about you?

items.chinese: 我去樓下找朋友，我們要一起去上課。
items.pinyin: Wǒ qù lóuxià zhǎo péngyǒu, wǒmen yào yìqǐ qù shàngkè.
items.english: I’m going downstairs to meet a friend. We are going to class together.

items.chinese: 歡迎你們來。
items.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen lái.
items.english: Welcome.

items.chinese: 你們學校真遠！
items.pinyin: Nǐmen xuéxiào zhēn yuǎn!
items.english: Your school is really far away!

items.chinese: 是啊，不是很近，有一點不方便。
items.pinyin: Shì a, bú shì hěn jìn, yǒu yìdiǎn bù fāngbiàn.
items.english: Yes, it is not very close. It is a little inconvenient.

items.chinese: 這裡的學生在哪裡買東西？
items.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de xuésheng zài nǎlǐ mǎi dōngxi?
items.english: Where do the students here buy things?

items.chinese: 在學校外面。學校裡面沒有商店。
items.pinyin: Zài xuéxiào wàimiàn. Xuéxiào lǐmiàn méiyǒu shāngdiàn.
items.english: Outside the school. There are no stores inside the school.

items.chinese: 吃飯呢？學校裡面有沒有餐廳？
items.pinyin: Chīfàn ne? Xuéxiào lǐmiàn yǒu méiyǒu cāntīng?
items.english: What about meals? Is there a restaurant inside the school?

items.chinese: 有，餐廳在學生宿舍的一樓。
items.pinyin: Yǒu, cāntīng zài xuésheng sùshè de yì lóu.
items.english: Yes. The restaurant is on the first floor of the student dormitory.

items.chinese: 前面這棟大樓很漂亮。
items.pinyin: Qiánmiàn zhè dòng dàlóu hěn piàoliang.
items.english: This building in front of us is very beautiful.

items.chinese: 這是圖書館，旁邊的那棟大樓是教室，圖書館後面有游泳池。
items.pinyin: Zhè shì túshūguǎn, pángbiān de nà dòng dàlóu shì jiàoshì, túshūguǎn hòumiàn yǒu yóuyǒngchí.
items.english: This is the library. The building beside it contains classrooms, and there is a swimming pool behind the library.

items.chinese: 月美，妳要去哪裡？
items.pinyin: Yuèměi, nǐ yào qù nǎlǐ?
items.english: Yuemei, where are you going?

items.chinese: 去KTV唱歌。我和朋友九點二十分在大安KTV見面。
items.pinyin: Qù KTV chànggē. Wǒ hé péngyǒu jiǔ diǎn èrshí fēn zài Dà’ān KTV jiànmiàn.
items.english: I’m going to sing at KTV. I’m meeting my friend at the Daan KTV at 9:20.

items.chinese: 早上九點去KTV？為什麼？
items.pinyin: Zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn qù KTV? Wèishénme?
items.english: Going to KTV at nine in the morning? Why?

items.chinese: 從早上七點到中午十二點，最便宜。要不要一起去？
items.pinyin: Cóng zǎoshang qī diǎn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn, zuì piányí. Yào bú yào yìqǐ qù?
items.english: It is cheapest from seven in the morning until noon. Would you like to come along?

items.chinese: 我想去，可是我得去銀行。下次吧！
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù, kěshì wǒ děi qù yínháng. Xià cì ba!
items.english: I want to go, but I have to go to the bank. Next time!

items.chinese: 好啊，下次你一定要來，我想聽你唱歌。
items.pinyin: Hǎo a, xià cì nǐ yídìng yào lái, wǒ xiǎng tīng nǐ chànggē.
items.english: Okay. You must come next time. I want to hear you sing.

items.chinese: 沒問題。對了，什麼時候有空一起吃飯？
items.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Duì le, shénme shíhou yǒu kòng yìqǐ chīfàn?
items.english: No problem. By the way, when are you free to have a meal together?

items.chinese: 後天我有空，你呢？
items.pinyin: Hòutiān wǒ yǒu kòng, nǐ ne?
items.english: I am free the day after tomorrow. What about you?

items.chinese: 我也有空，後天晚上七點怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǒu kòng, hòutiān wǎnshang qī diǎn zěnmeyàng?
items.english: I am free too. How about seven in the evening the day after tomorrow?

items.chinese: 好啊！再見。
items.pinyin: Hǎo a! Zàijiàn.
items.english: Sounds good! Goodbye.

items.chinese: 如玉，妳在吃飯啊？
items.pinyin: Rúyù, nǐ zài chīfàn a?
items.english: Ruyu, are you eating?

items.chinese: 是，吃午餐，等一下要上課。你呢？
items.pinyin: Shì, chī wǔcān, děng yíxià yào shàngkè. Nǐ ne?
items.english: Yes, I’m eating lunch. I have class shortly. What about you?

items.chinese: 我剛下課。對了，下午四點半學校有籃球比賽。妳想去看嗎？
items.pinyin: Wǒ gāng xiàkè. Duì le, xiàwǔ sì diǎn bàn xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài. Nǐ xiǎng qù kàn ma?
items.english: I just finished class. By the way, the school has a basketball game at 4:30 this afternoon. Would you like to watch it?

items.chinese: 想啊。比賽幾點結束？
items.pinyin: Xiǎng a. Bǐsài jǐ diǎn jiéshù?
items.english: Yes. What time does the game end?

items.chinese: 六點半。妳晚上有事嗎？
items.pinyin: Liù diǎn bàn. Nǐ wǎnshang yǒu shì ma?
items.english: At 6:30. Are you busy this evening?

items.chinese: 我最近很忙，每天晚上都上書法課。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn hěn máng, měitiān wǎnshang dōu shàng shūfǎ kè.
items.english: I have been very busy recently. I attend calligraphy class every evening.

items.chinese: 學得怎麼樣？
items.pinyin: Xué de zěnmeyàng?
items.english: How is your learning going?

items.chinese: 剛開始學，字寫得不好，可是我覺得很有意思。
items.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ xué, zì xiě de bù hǎo, kěshì wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
items.english: I have only just started. I do not write the characters well, but I find it very interesting.

items.chinese: 我有空可以去看看嗎？
items.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu kòng kěyǐ qù kànkan ma?
items.english: Can I come and have a look when I am free?

items.chinese: 我得問問老師。
items.pinyin: Wǒ děi wènwen lǎoshī.
items.english: I have to ask the teacher.

items.chinese: 這個週末，我想跟朋友去臺南玩。
items.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò, wǒ xiǎng gēn péngyǒu qù Táinán wán.
items.english: This weekend, I want to go to Tainan with friends for fun.

items.chinese: 怎麼去？
items.pinyin: Zěnme qù?
items.english: How are you going to get there?

items.chinese: 我想坐火車去
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò huǒchē qù
items.english: I want to take the train.

items.chinese: 火車太慢了，要四個多鐘頭，坐高鐵比較快。
items.pinyin: Huǒchē tài màn le, yào sì ge duō zhōngtóu, zuò gāotiě bǐjiào kuài.
items.english: The train is too slow. It takes more than four hours. Taking high-speed rail is faster.

items.chinese: 可是聽說高鐵車票非常貴。
items.pinyin: Kěshì tīngshuō gāotiě chēpiào fēicháng guì.
items.english: But I heard that high-speed rail tickets are very expensive.

items.chinese: 高鐵車票有一點貴，但是坐高鐵又快又舒服。
items.pinyin: Gāotiě chēpiào yǒu yìdiǎn guì, dànshì zuò gāotiě yòu kuài yòu shūfú.
items.english: High-speed rail tickets are a little expensive, but taking high-speed rail is both fast and comfortable.

items.chinese: 我不知道在哪裡買票。
items.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào zài nǎlǐ mǎi piào.
items.english: I do not know where to buy tickets.

items.chinese: 在高鐵站、網路上或是便利商店都可以。
items.pinyin: Zài gāotiě zhàn, wǎnglù shàng huòshì biànlì shāngdiàn dōu kěyǐ.
items.english: You can buy them at a high-speed rail station, online, or at a convenience store.

items.chinese: 這麼方便！那我坐高鐵去，謝謝你。
items.pinyin: Zhème fāngbiàn! Nà wǒ zuò gāotiě qù, xièxie nǐ.
items.english: So convenient! Then I will take high-speed rail. Thank you.

items.chinese: 安同，明天我們沒課，你想去哪裡？
items.pinyin: Āntóng, míngtiān wǒmen méi kè, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
items.english: Antong, we have no classes tomorrow. Where would you like to go?

items.chinese: 我要跟同學去參觀故宮博物院。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yào gēn tóngxué qù cānguān Gùgōng Bówùyuàn.
items.english: I am going to visit the National Palace Museum with my classmates.

items.chinese: 聽說那裡有很多中國古代的東西。
items.pinyin: Tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu hěn duō Zhōngguó gǔdài de dōngxi.
items.english: I heard there are many things from ancient China there.

items.chinese: 是啊。妳要跟我們去看看嗎？
items.pinyin: Shì a. Nǐ yào gēn wǒmen qù kànkan ma?
items.english: Yes. Would you like to come and have a look with us?

items.chinese: 好。怎麼去？
items.pinyin: Hǎo. Zěnme qù?
items.english: Sure. How are we getting there?

items.chinese: 我同學騎機車載我。妳可以坐公共汽車去。
items.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué qí jīchē zài wǒ. Nǐ kěyǐ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù.
items.english: My classmate is giving me a ride on a scooter. You can take the bus.

items.chinese: 我想坐捷運去。比較快。
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù. Bǐjiào kuài.
items.english: I want to take the MRT. It is faster.

items.chinese: 不行，到故宮沒有捷運。妳要不要坐計程車去？
items.pinyin: Bù xíng, dào Gùgōng méi yǒu jiéyùn. Nǐ yào bú yào zuò jìchéngchē qù?
items.english: That will not work. There is no MRT to the Palace Museum. Would you like to take a taxi?

items.chinese: 太貴了！我坐公車。騎機車比坐公車快嗎？
items.pinyin: Tài guì le! Wǒ zuò gōngchē. Qí jīchē bǐ zuò gōngchē kuài ma?
items.english: Too expensive! I will take the bus. Is riding a scooter faster than taking the bus?

items.chinese: 差不多。
items.pinyin: Chàbuduō.
items.english: It takes about the same time.

items.chinese: 田中，下個星期我們放五天的假，你要回國嗎？
items.pinyin: Tiánzhōng, xià ge xīngqí wǒmen fàng wǔ tiān de jià, nǐ yào huíguó ma?
items.english: Tianzhong, we have five days off next week. Are you going back to your home country?

items.chinese: 不，我打算在家看電視、影片學中文，你呢？
items.pinyin: Bù, wǒ dǎsuàn zài jiā kàn diànshì, yǐngpiàn xué Zhōngwén, nǐ ne?
items.english: No, I plan to stay home and learn Chinese by watching TV and videos. What about you?

items.chinese: 我想跟朋友去玩。
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn péngyǒu qù wán.
items.english: I would like to go on a trip with friends.

items.chinese: 不錯啊。去什麼地方？
items.pinyin: Búcuò a. Qù shénme dìfang?
items.english: Sounds good. Where are you going?

items.chinese: 臺東。聽說那裡的風景非常漂亮。
items.pinyin: Táidōng. Tīngshuō nàlǐ de fēngjǐng fēicháng piàoliang.
items.english: Taitung. I hear the scenery there is very beautiful.

items.chinese: 我也聽說。放假的時候，你常去旅行嗎？
items.pinyin: Wǒ yě tīngshuō. Fàngjià de shíhou, nǐ cháng qù lǚxíng ma?
items.english: I have heard that too. Do you often travel when you have time off?

items.chinese: 不一定。有時候在家寫功課，有時候出去玩。
items.pinyin: Bù yídìng. Yǒu shíhou zài jiā xiě gōngkè, yǒu shíhou chūqù wán.
items.english: Not always. Sometimes I do homework at home, and sometimes I go out for fun.

items.chinese: 你們什麼時候去臺東？
items.pinyin: Nǐmen shénme shíhou qù Táidōng?
items.english: When are you going to Taitung?

items.chinese: 這個星期六下午去。
items.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqíliù xiàwǔ qù.
items.english: We are going this Saturday afternoon.

items.chinese: 去玩多久？
items.pinyin: Qù wán duō jiǔ?
items.english: How long will you stay?

items.chinese: 大概玩四、五天。
items.pinyin: Dàgài wán sì, wǔ tiān.
items.english: About four or five days.

items.chinese: 我女朋友九月三十號要來臺灣看我。
items.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ péngyǒu jiǔ yuè sānshí hào yào lái Táiwān kàn wǒ.
items.english: My girlfriend is coming to Taiwan to visit me on September 30.

items.chinese: 你想帶她去哪裡玩？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng dài tā qù nǎlǐ wán?
items.english: Where would you like to take her for fun?

items.chinese: 還不知道。你有什麼建議？
items.pinyin: Hái bù zhīdào. Nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì?
items.english: I do not know yet. Do you have any suggestions?

items.chinese: 臺灣的夜市很有名，你們應該去逛逛。
items.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒumíng, nǐmen yīnggāi qù guàngguang.
items.english: Taiwan's night markets are very famous. You should go and look around.

items.chinese: 謝謝，還有什麼好玩的地方？
items.pinyin: Xièxie, hái yǒu shénme hǎowán de dìfang?
items.english: Thank you. What other fun places are there?

items.chinese: 臺灣的茶也很特別。臺北有很多茶館。
items.pinyin: Táiwān de chá yě hěn tèbié. Táiběi yǒu hěn duō cháguǎn.
items.english: Taiwanese tea is also special. There are many teahouses in Taipei.

items.chinese: 到哪裡喝茶比較好？
items.pinyin: Dào nǎlǐ hē chá bǐjiào hǎo?
items.english: Where would be a good place to have tea?

items.chinese: 你們可以去貓空。那裡的風景很美。
items.pinyin: Nǐmen kěyǐ qù Māokōng. Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
items.english: You can go to Maokong. The scenery there is beautiful.

items.chinese: 謝謝你。我決定帶她去貓空。你也一起去，好不好？
items.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ. Wǒ juédìng dài tā qù Māokōng. Nǐ yě yìqǐ qù, hǎo bù hǎo?
items.english: Thank you. I have decided to take her to Maokong. Would you like to come along too?

items.chinese: 要是那時候我有空，就跟你們一起去。
items.pinyin: Yàoshì nà shíhou wǒ yǒu kòng, jiù gēn nǐmen yìqǐ qù.
items.english: If I am free then, I will go with you.

items.chinese: 太好了！謝謝！
items.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie!
items.english: Great! Thank you!
